name: Viboplr Community
author: Viboplr
description: Share your Now Playing cue sheets, your synced lyrics and your playlists (as mixtapes) on Viboplr Community, and play or import what other people made. Signed-in members can also add the Subsonic / Navidrome servers their owners opened to the community. Sign in with GitHub to publish or to see shared servers; browsing, playing and importing everything else needs no account.

apiUsage.reason: Browse, import and publish on community.viboplr.com
Sign in with GitHub in your browser, and open an item's page on the server
Install a cue sheet you chose to import
List your own sheets so you can publish them
Find shared sheets for the song that's playing
Publish the queue as a mixtape, when you ask to
List your playlists so you can publish them, and know which mixtapes you saved
Read the track list of a playlist you publish (titles and artists only, never file paths)
Save a mixtape you chose to your Playlists
Replace a saved mixtape with its newer version, when you update it
Make synced lyrics you chose to import the song's lyrics
Read a song's synced lyrics when you publish them, and look the song up again when you undo an import
Open the app's Add Server dialog for a listed server — you confirm there
